description: This file defines the 'ValueConverter' class within the SCSSPHP library, responsible for parsing SCSS values from source strings and converting PHP values into Sass-compatible values. It serves as a utility class for value manipulation in the compiler.

classes.name: ValueConverter
classes.description: A final utility class that provides static methods to parse SCSS values from source strings and convert PHP values into Sass-compatible formats.

methods.name: parseValue
methods.description: Parses a string source into a SCSS value, returning supported internal representations or throwing an exception if invalid.

methods.name: fromPhp
methods.description: Converts a PHP value into a corresponding Sass value, supporting numbers, null, booleans, strings, and arrays with specific types.
